item.title: Scarlet – Watch the trailer for the new time-bending anime
item.description: From visionary Academy Award®-nominated filmmaker Mamoru Hosoda (MIRAI) comes a powerful, time-bending animated adventure. SCARLET, a sword-wielding princess from a war-torn medieval kingdom, sets to avenge her father’s death – but fails, awakening in a mysterious afterlife. There, she meets an idealistic young man from our present day whose compassion challenges her thirst for vengeance. […]

item.title: Bowie: The Final Act – Watch the trailer for the new David Bowie documentary
item.description: Ten years after David Bowie’s passing, his final chapter comes to light. Discover how the legendary artist transformed life, death, and creativity into his haunting masterpiece, Blackstar. Rare archives, intimate interviews, and Bowie’s own words reveal a resurrection that continues to inspire. In UK cinemas from 26 December. You can book tickets here.
